requirement: Website Opportunities Details: a site brief opens in its own dsh side-card tab; Details lists every demo and the latest brief's status

oracle.invariant: 0 failures. Demos list newest first, numbered by age, each with its CMS, template, state and the number of the brief it came from; a row without an id is dropped; none is an empty list. The brief status is the latest brief with whether the research still reads the same (true, false, or unknown kept as null); no brief, or one without an id, is nothing.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: demoRows: every demo newest first, numbered by age, with its CMS, template, state and the brief it came from
briefStatus: the latest brief and whether the research still reads the same; nothing without a brief
tests: demoRows: every demo newest first, numbered by age, with its CMS, template, state and the brief it came from
briefStatus: the latest brief and whether the research still reads the same; nothing without a brief
